$comment: SDK v1 capability catalog (user spec 2026-09-30, sdk/API.md). 'core' calls need no permission (plugin info, lifecycle, logger, config, utils, locale, resources, rate limits). Every other call needs its permission switched on in the SDK policies (admin > SDK Policies, table sdk_policies; default: risk low = on, otherwise off) and declared in the plugin manifest. Plugins never get a database handle, the bot token, environment variables or direct network access; every call goes through the SDK manager in the bot. 'implemented' lists the calls the manager answers today; the others answer sdk.call.not_available. Texts: dashboard lang keys sdk.perm.<key> and sdk.perm.<key>_hint. Every permission has a main "group" (the SDK policies page shows the groups alphabetically, each one opens to its permissions). "replaced" maps old coarse keys to the finer ones: a manifest that names an old key is read as if it named the new keys. Discord events: a plugin needs the discord.events.* permission whose "events" list holds the event. Module permissions: modules.<module>.<area>; "scope": "module" entries (modules.<key>.read) share the module.* calls of modules.read, which allows every module, while modules.<key>.read allows that one module only. "category" is the module group of shared/modules.json.

permissions.$comment: Posts an image of the plugin files (storage.files) as an attachment: message.sendFile(channelId, fileName, message?). In the message, image "attachment" shows it inside the embed. spoiler: true blurs it until clicked.

A full copy of a server structure (roles with permissions, channels with overwrites, slowmode, bitrate and user limit, emojis, bans, settings) saved as a JSON plugin file; the plugin gets its name and counts. Needs storage.files.

Builds a server from a backup file (guild.snapshot): roles, channels with permission overwrites, emojis, settings, optionally bans. mode "add" or "replace" (deletes channels and the roles the bot may manage first). Never hands out Administrator; managed roles are skipped. Needs storage.files.
services.tasks in bothub.json ({name, every} min. 1m, or {name, cron} in UTC) + definePlugin({tasks}); scheduler.* calls stay planned.

Files per bot: images (PNG, GIF, WEBP, JPEG) and other files with their original name (no programs); max. 8 MB each, 100 files, 50 MB. Uploaded in the dashboard for "image" settings fields (images only), or stored by the plugin: base64 (files.put, a file name allows other types) or a Discord attachment link (files.fromDiscord, cdn.discordapp.com / media.discordapp.net only). Name = content hash + extension. interaction.reply / followUp can send one (options.file).

Data Storage variables of the bot ({var.<key>} in the Custom Command Builder and the Message Builder): the plugin creates, changes and deletes its own (data_variables.plugin_id) and reads and writes their values. Keys of other variables are refused; the plugin's variables go when it is uninstalled.
Status and latency of any public http(s) URL (website monitors): never the page content, never home-network addresses, at most 3 redirects, 60 checks per minute per bot.

HTTP requests with admin secrets the plugin never sees: the address from a secret (any address the admin set) or an https URL of services.hosts (public only), a key from a secret into a header or URL parameter. Only names of services.secrets the admin shared; values masked in the answer. Response max. 1 MB, timeout 10 s. With storage.files: file { name, field } sends a stored image as multipart/form-data (plus text fields); saveAs 'file' stores an image answer (max. 2 MB) in the plugin files.
Only secrets listed in the manifest 'services.secrets' AND shared by the admin (secret_plugin_shares); other names answer null, there is no list call. Values are masked in the plugin's log lines.
